summary: The SiteRecruitmentResources manage recruitment resources within the HSPnet application, leveraging various UI components and controls for interaction and data handling. It supports functionalities such as viewing, editing, and updating recruitment details.
purpose: To provide a user interface for managing site recruitment resources, including displaying details, editing records, and handling recruitment statuses.

fields.name: RecruitmentReferenceNumber
fields.description: A unique reference number for the recruitment.

fields.name: RecruitmentClosed
fields.description: A status indicating whether the recruitment is closed.

fields.name: SiteID
fields.description: The unique identifier for the site.

fields.name: WebPage
fields.description: The URL or identifier for the webpage related to the recruitment resources.

actors.name: User
actors.description: The end user interacting with the SiteRecruitmentResources interface.

workflows.name: Edit Recruitment
steps: User clicks on the edit button to modify recruitment details.
The uxDetail control switches to edit mode.
The user makes changes to the recruitment reference number or status.
User saves the changes which are then updated in the database.

business_rules: The recruitment status can only be updated if the user has editing permissions.
validations: Check if the UserSession is valid before allowing database operations.
Ensure recruitment reference number is a valid string.
conditions: If UserSession is null, cancel database selection operations.
system_behavior: The system updates the recruitment details in the database when saved.
Pop-up modal for details is displayed using AjaxControlToolkit.
